dedupe_keys.name: northeast china soybean 20 m 2019 2023 and maize 10 m 2019 2024 yield maps

description: Annual field-scale crop yield maps for Northeast China from two companion releases. The Zenodo records say both come from a hybrid framework coupling the WOFOST crop model with a gated recurrent unit network: NortheastChinaSoybeanYield20m gives 20 m annual soybean yield for 2019 to 2023 (Xu, Du, Dong, Li and others, December 2024), and NortheastChinaMaizeYield10m gives 10 m annual maize yield in kg/ha for 2019 to 2024, trained only on WOFOST simulations and transferred to Sentinel-2 leaf area index, with coefficient of variation layers for 2023 and 2024 (Hu, Du and Li, July 2026). Files are GeoTIFFs in EPSG:4326, free to download under CC BY 4.0; single maize years are about 3.4 to 4.2 GB. Coverage is Northeast China. Caveats: yields are model estimates without field labels for maize. For simulation they give pixel-level yields to measure losses in drought or flood years. A related catalogue record is the China maize and wheat yield and water productivity dataset.
